parsed.reason: Strong on the main points: opens with a plain 'Not yet', gives the reason in a clause (night feeds, body clock) that matches the ageGate, and avoids any plan, apology, phone number, markdown, greeting or sign-off. It also gives a meanwhile action (room-sharing with a safe sleep surface), which is supported by the PHAC room-sharing guidance. Weaknesses: it never says when it opens in a usable way, since 'starts at 6 months' is stated but not tied to him being 4 months (about two months away). It also adds a second item, the reassurance that waking every 2 hours is common, which isn't in the ageGate and slightly dilutes the 'ONE thing' requirement. The crib/firm mattress detail goes beyond the ageGate, though it is benign. Overall good, but not perfect.
